nodes.name: Webhook - Assessment Submitted
nodes.notes: POST the scored assessment here. Swap for a DB trigger or form node if you are not calling this over HTTP.

nodes.name: Prepare Input
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for input shape + model/temperature config. Edit CONFIG here to change model.

nodes.name: Build Agent 1 Request
nodes.notes: Insight extraction prompt + strict JSON schema.

nodes.name: Parse Agent 1
nodes.notes: Parses output and recomputes every benchmark gap from source data - the model never supplies a number that reaches the report.

nodes.name: Build Dashboard Data
nodes.notes: Deterministic. No LLM. Chart data comes straight from the scored input so charts can never contradict the prose.

nodes.name: Build Agent 3 Request
nodes.notes: Narrative-only prompt. Dashboard figures passed in read-only.
